title: Context barrel omits LanguageContext exports
reasoning: The contexts barrel exports AuthContext only, even though LanguageContext is part of the same owned source group and exposes public symbols. Code using the app-local barrel pattern (`@/contexts`) cannot import LanguageProvider, useLanguage, or Language from the index, while AuthContext works. The current LanguageContext tests import directly from `../LanguageContext`, so this public export gap is not exercised.
reproduction: Attempt `import { LanguageProvider, useLanguage } from '@/contexts'`; TypeScript will not find those exports because the barrel only re-exports AuthContext.
recommendation: Re-export LanguageContext from `app/contexts/index.ts`, or remove the barrel if direct module imports are the intended contract everywhere.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: LanguageContext tests import the implementation file directly instead of the contexts barrel, so they do not validate that the source group's public index exports all expected context APIs.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a small barrel export test or compile-time import check that imports AuthProvider, useAuth, LanguageProvider, useLanguage, and Language from `../index`.
minimumFixScope: Add `export * from './LanguageContext';` to `app/contexts/index.ts` and cover the barrel import contract.
